proposal.reason: Main change is CI test orchestration: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E) workflow execution, case generation/grouping/reconciliation, optional HPN SDK install in workflow jobs, and expanded xtest coverage/reporting inputs (including the patch-omitted postsil_unit_test_shm test-list data).
